== Description ==

At a long table at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025: [[Phil Aasen]] (front left, grey flat cap and black jacket), [[Amar Banger]] (top right, olive hoodie and beard), and [[Brian Fred]] (front right, black Colts sleeveless jersey), with a fourth player in a grey long-sleeve shirt (top left, unlabeled).
